sources.quote: HD 212771, also named Lionrock, is a solitary star in the equatorial-southern zodiac constellation of Aquarius.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.4 solar radii and 1.80 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,253 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
